remarks: Discover unparalleled modern living at The Village at River's Edge in the vibrant heart of Stamford, CT. This exceptional townhouse offers a seamless blend of luxury and convenience with its expansive, open-concept layout designed to impress. As you enter, you'll find a cozy living space that exudes warmth and charm, ideal for relaxing or hosting gatherings. The fluid transition between the living room, dining area, and kitchen enhances the space, making it perfect for both intimate and larger-scale entertaining. The kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring elegant stainless steel appliances and ample space to bring your culinary creations to life. One of the unique highlights of this home is the versatile bonus room, which can serve as a cozy family room or a private office, adapting to your lifestyle needs and preferences. The two generously sized bedrooms offer a tranquil escape, ensuring restful nights and rejuvenating mornings. Residents also enjoy exclusive access to community amenities, including a refreshing pool and a well-equipped gym. Convenience is at your fingertips with this prime location, putting you just moments away from a rich selection of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Whether you're exploring the dynamic food scene, indulging in retail therapy, or relaxing in nearby parks, everything you need is within easy reach. Seize the chance to call this remarkable townhouse your new home and experience a lifestyle of comfort and sophistication.
